notes.title: Patch Notes - Atmosphere Update
notes.content: [p]This update brings a small but important touch to [i]Alien Grounds[/i]:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Mission Soundtracks[/b] - Added two fresh tracks to expand the atmosphere and keep the action intense.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Code Cleanup[/b] - Minor backend improvements for stability and smoother development going forward.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback - every little update brings us closer to the full version of [i]Alien Grounds[/i].[/p]

notes.title: New Gun Coming - Which One Do You Want?
notes.content:
[p]I’ve been cooking up ideas for the next big weapon update, and the top three contenders are:[/p][list][*][p][b]Black Hole Gun[/b] - Sucks enemies into oblivion (inspired by mechanics from my next horror sim project).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sat Gun[/b] - Orbital strike goodness from above.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tunnel Effect Gun[/b] - Creates deadly passages enemies won’t escape from.[/p][/*][/list][p]Each one could be tuned for [b]mass kills[/b] (like the Chem Gun) or [b]single-target power[/b] (like a Gravity Gun). Personally, I think mass-kill is more useful for higher missions - but I want to hear what you think.[/p][p]The Black Hole Gun can be done pretty quickly with some special effects, but since it’s an area weapon I’ll need to nail the balance so it doesn’t break the game.[/p][p][b]Expected release: ~30 days[/b]
In the meantime, please tell your friends about [i]Alien Grounds[/i] - it’s still 100% free, and more players means more fun (and more crazy weapons).[/p]

notes.title: What’s Next After Achievements?
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]Achievements are here to stay - more are coming over the next few months. Some are clearly favorites, others not so much. I think of them as mini-games in their own right, and each one deserves to be thoughtfully designed.[/p][p][b]So, what’s next?[/b][/p][p]I’m working on adding more weapons. The gravity gun seems to be a step in the right direction - expect more sci-fi-punk-style tools with real physics and solid usability. Weird, fun, and grounded (literally).[/p][p]Also, I’m looking for an animator and asset designer to help move away from the “asset flip” look. If you or someone you know might be interested, feel free to reach out. It’s unpaid, being a hobby project for now - just being upfront.[/p][p]Thanks for playing and testing. You’re helping shape this thing.[/p][p]
— emagnetic[/p]

notes.title: 🔁 Replay and Score Tracking
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, [/p][p] [/p][p][b]🆕 Replay Button Added[/b]
At the end of a mission, you can now hit [b]Replay[/b] to retry the same mission and improve your score.[/p][list][*][p]You can replay a mission as many times as you want before moving on to the next mission.[/p][/*][*][p]Your [b]highest score[/b] is automatically saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Useful for earning achievements (like Hard 1 Blitz) or aiming for a higher leaderboard score (when leaderboards arrive).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]

⭐ Gold Stars for Strong Performance[/b]

Each mission now starts with default ammo and health instead of carrying them over. This ensures consistency for future leaderboards and makes mission logic more transparent.[/p][p][/p][p]This game is evolving  if you notice bugs, have balance suggestions, or want to share your thoughts on the new features, let me know![/p][p][/p][p]—emagnetic[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 New: Raw Gamepad Input
notes.content:
Based on feedback from power users in the controller community, I’ve added a new Raw Gamepad Input option.

This mode bypasses all in-game processing (dead zones, curves, sensitivity scaling) and lets you fine-tune your controller externally - through hardware software, drivers, or Steam Input.

You can toggle Raw Gamepad Input in the game’s Settings menu. It’s a small but important step toward smoother controller play - especially on high-end pads and Steam Deck.

In addition, maps now look noticeably better on low graphics settings. I’ve reworked lighting and skylight handling to improve visual quality without increasing performance cost.

Huge thanks to the r/controller community for the feedback and expertise!

notes.title: ⚠️ Enemy Behind Alert - Update #4 is Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Big thanks to [i]AndersonSmith[/i] on Reddit for highlighting a key issue - no warning when enemies approach from behind.

With a boost from alien tech and your feedback, here’s what’s added:

[h3]⚠️ Enemy Behind Alert[/h3]
The HUD alert triggers when these conditions are met:
[olist]
[*] The player is not moving or moving backward
[*] An enemy is within the backward alert cone (the cone narrows with higher backward speed)
[*] The player is not turning too fast
[/olist]
It’s a small change that adds real situational awareness - especially on tougher waves.
Don’t like it? You can fully customize it in Settings:
[list]
[*] [b]Visual + Beep[/b]
[*] [b]Visual Only[/b] (default)
[*] [b]Beep Only[/b]
[*] [b]Off[/b]
[/list]
Test it out and let me know if it helps. I’m always listening - and updating.

— emagnetic

notes.title: 📢 Story is Coming to Alien Grounds (Starting Update #5)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A lot of you asked for it - and you're right. Alien Grounds needs more meaning behind the chaos.

So here's the deal: I'm starting to build a story into the main game itself, not as a separate mode, but woven into the experience - one piece at a time, starting with Update #5.

Now, my Hollywood team went on strike when I couldn’t afford coffee, so I’ll be writing this myself. Expect short transmissions, map context, weird signals, and a hint that there’s more going on beneath the surface...

What’s the story?
Let’s just say it’s… waking up.

— emagnetic

[h3]🎮 Difficulty Modes Overview[/h3]

[b]🧊 Chill Mode[/b] [i](Proposed)[/i]

notes.title: Alien Grounds – Free FPS Launches April 9
notes.content:
[b]The time has come.[/b]

After months of development, playtesting, and feedback from early players, [b]Alien Grounds[/b] is launching as a [b]full, free-to-play sci-fi FPS[/b] on [b]April 9, 2025[/b].

I'm a solo developer, and it’s been amazing to see the interest and support from players who tried the demo during [b]Next Fest[/b]. Your support has meant a lot, and I’m excited (and nervous!) to finally release the full game.

This is a [b]gritty, atmospheric sci-fi FPS[/b], built with love and way too much coffee—featuring fast-paced combat, alien threats, and a fight for survival on hostile ground.
If you enjoyed the demo, there’s much more waiting in the full release.

🚀 [b]Full game goes live April 9[/b]
🛑 [b]The demo will be removed[/b] from the store on launch day
📌 [b]Wishlist now[/b] to get notified when it drops!

Thanks again to everyone who’s been part of this early journey.
Can’t wait to hear what you think.

— [i]Emagnetic[/i]

[b]Exciting News, Alien Grounds Fans![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that Alien Grounds, our fast-paced, action-packed first-person shooter, plans to showcase its exclusive demo during the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 🚀🎮

[b]📅 Mark your calendars:[/b] From February 25th to March 4th, you’ll get an early hands-on experience with the game, exploring its unique alien battlegrounds and adrenaline-pumping combat—all for free!

Here’s what you’ll experience in the demo:

[list]
[*] [b]Fast-Paced FPS Action:[/b] Take on relentless waves of enemies in intense battles.
[*] [b]Unique Alien Weapons:[/b] Master an arsenal of extraterrestrial firepower.
[*] [b]Stunning Visuals:[/b] Immerse yourself in atmospheric 3D landscapes filled with mysterious artifacts.
[*] [b]Diverse Worlds:[/b] Explore dynamic environments enriched with distinctive visuals and effects.
[/list]
[b]💥 Add Alien Grounds to your Wishlist[/b] to get notified as soon as the demo goes live during Next Fest!

[b]👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351550/Alien_Grounds/]Wishlist Alien Grounds on Steam[/url][/b]

[b]Don’t miss your chance to play the demo and join the conversation as we gear up for Alien Grounds’ full launch. Let’s conquer the battlefield together! 👽✨[/b]
